sections.en: Combustion of the five wandering planets

summary.headline: Combustion of the Five Planets
summary.text: Astrological predictions for solitary, isolated, or combust planets, especially Saturn in Cancer and Leo, covering deaths of rulers, calamities, famine, disease, winds, crop blight, water shortages, price changes, and regional hardship. An anecdotal warning recounts Sultan Osman’s assassination in Rajab 1301 AH after Saturn’s conjunction with Mars.
